description: Interior and exterior painting for Jacksonville homes and commercial properties. One team handles the prep, the paint and the repairs. 5.0 on Google from 25 reviews.

headline:
We don't sell paint.
We sell transformation.
intro: Interior and exterior painting for Jacksonville homes and commercial properties. One team handles the prep, the paint and the repairs.
servicesIntro: One room or the whole house. Every estimate is free and flat.

services.name: Interior Painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings, trim and doors, with a smooth, clean finish and the work area protected.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.text: Stucco, siding, trim, doors and garage doors, prepped to hold up in Florida heat, rain and sun.

services.name: Staining and Refinishing
services.text: Wood features, doors, staircases and cabinets restored where the old finish has worn.

services.name: Cabinet Painting and Detail Work
services.text: Cabinet painting, touch-ups and patching that refresh a space without a full remodel.

services.name: Commercial Building Painting
services.text: Offices, restaurants and retail centers painted on a schedule that limits disruption.

services.name: Pressure Washing and Waterproofing
services.text: Exterior prep and protection, including block sealing, ahead of paint.

why.name: Owners on every job
why.text: You deal directly with company leaders from estimate to final walkthrough, not a subcontractor chain.

why.name: Free estimates, warranted work
why.text: Transparent pricing, free estimates and fully warranted workmanship.

why.name: Clean job sites
why.text: Strict cleanliness and respect for your home or business.

howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: We look at the work, ask questions and give you a flat price.

steps.name: We prep and paint
steps.text: We mask, scrape, caulk and prime, then paint. We buy all the supplies.

steps.name: Pay when it is done
steps.text: On most jobs, you pay nothing until everything is completely finished.
